info.description: The API the Goblin Gate web UI uses. Authenticate with an API token (System → API Tokens) as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or with the web UI's session cookie plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header (the value of the `gg_csrf` cookie) on every request that changes something. Configuration changes go to the candidate configuration and take effect with POST /api/v1/commit. `x-goblin-scope` names the token scope an operation needs: `admin` = full admin tokens only, `candidate` = the scope of the configuration section changed.
